intent: Offer Review with AI or Continue without AI with optional fields/upload/disclosures collapsed. Free editing/export makes no AI request or credit use; Back preserves edited text. Studio source collection follows the new wrappers and vacancy invalidation resets free-edit mode.

findings.title: Back during PDF loading exports an empty document
findings.why_it_matters: On the free editing path, a user can click Back while Download PDF is awaiting its dynamic module import. Back invalidates the editable state before the export constructs its document, so the resulting PDF contains no CV text even though the preserved text remains on the choice screen.
evidence: src/review-ui.js:55: invalidate() sets s.original='';s.edited='';s.originalLetter='';s.editedLetter=''. The Back handler restores only s.text and s.letter.
src/review-ui.js:78: PDF export sets s.busy=true, repaints, then awaits import('./pdf.js') before calling downloadDocument(reviewedDocument(s.edited,s.editedLetter),'CV-Hapi-reviewed.pdf').
Constructed sequence: import a 587-character example CV, Continue without AI, check facts, click Download PDF, click the still-enabled Back button before the asynchronous import resolves.

Read-only esbuild/JSDOM reproduction replaced only pdf.js downloadDocument with an argument recorder, preserving the dynamic-import boundary. It printed 'Back during export disabled: false' and captured a PDF definition with content:[] instead of the 587-character CV. No source files were changed.
findings.suggested_fix: Disable #review-choice-back when s.busy and return immediately from its click handler when s.busy, matching other actions that can replace review state. Verify that Back cannot clear edited text while PDF export is awaiting the import.
findings.validation_reason: Original export race was reproduced with an empty PDF definition. Both busy guards now prevent Back from clearing edited state during export.

resolution.verification: Disabled Back and direct onclick attempts preserve all 587 editor characters while export loads; both export definitions remain nonempty.
